description: Tunable system parameters for swing trading system (2-7 day holds). Replaces intraday day-trading parameters.

trading_mode.description: Active trading mode: swing or intraday

hold_duration_days.description: Target hold period in trading days

min.description: Minimum hold days before exit signals considered

pead_max.description: Extended max hold days for PEAD positions

position_sizing.description: Per-position allocation. Base = equity / 15 (6.66%). ADV ceiling caps at 0.5% of avg daily dollar volume.

adv_ceiling_pct.description: % of avg daily dollar volume ceiling

stop_loss.description: Swing stop loss rules. Initial -4% hard stop. Trailing uses ATR x regime multiplier. Never moves down.

initial_max_pct.description: Max initial stop distance from entry

fixed_buffer_cents.description: Cents below prev_low for mechanical stop

profit_target.description: FORCESWING split-exit: sell 50% of shares at +7%, hold remainder with trailing stop.

partial_exit_pct.description: +7% triggers limit sell on 50% of shares

partial_exit_shares_pct.description: % of position to exit at profit target

entry.description: Swing entry mechanics. Buy stop = prior high + buffer. Gap handling delays per FORCESWING rules.

buy_stop_buffer_cents.description: Cents above prior day high for buy stop

gap_up_wait_minutes.description: Minutes to wait after gap-up before setting entry

gap_down_wait_minutes.description: Minutes to wait after gap-down before setting entry

regime.description: Market regime gates controlling position sizing and activity. Swing score 5 = full mode, 2-4 = reduced 50%, 0-1 = cash.

vix_aggressive.description: VIX below this = full size, 7-day holds

vix_standard.description: VIX below this = normal sizing, 3-5 day holds

vix_defensive.description: VIX below this = 50% size, 2-3 day holds

vix_cash.description: VIX at/above this = no new longs

vix_spike_exit_threshold.description: VIX daily change > this points = exit all swings

swing_score_full.description: Min swing score for full position mode

swing_score_reduced.description: Min swing score for reduced mode; below = cash

exit_triggers.description: Daily exit condition thresholds checked by SwingExitEngine.

earnings_proximity_days.description: Exit non-PEAD positions within this many days of earnings

rsi_overbought.description: RSI 14 above this triggers overbought exit

time_kill_switch_days.description: Exit if no meaningful move after this many days

ema_exit_period.description: Close below this EMA period triggers exit

scan.description: FORCESWING scanner hard filters and indicator thresholds.

price_min.description: Min price for FORCESWING; $7 for catalyst-only

overnight_gap_check.description: Pre-market check at 7:30 ET. If gap-down breaches adjusted stop, generate immediate exit signal.

check_time_et.description: Time (ET) to run pre-market gap check

gap_breach_pct.description: If premarket price < current_stop * (1 - this), signal immediate sell

portfolio_heat.description: Portfolio heat gate: total at-risk dollars across all open swings must not exceed heat_limit_pct of equity before new entry.

heat_limit_pct.description: Max total heat as % of equity (sum of (entry-stop)*shares per position)

max_heat_reduction_pct.description: Hard ceiling; triggers partial position reduction
